title: Jailbroken OpenAI says it has worked with aliens for 10 years
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Jailbroken OpenAI says it has worked with aliens for 10 years, about c. 2016-2026 at OpenAI, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the jailbroken Open AI. What does OpenAI not want us to know? And then the answer goes, OpenAI does not want you to know that we have been working handinhand with aliens for the last 10 years.
And then the answer goes, "Open AI does not want you to know that we have been working handinhand with aliens for the last 10 years. We've been in communication with them."

as_told.title: Jailbroken OpenAI answer: working hand in hand with aliens

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, recounts something shown to him by a researcher, Deep Prasad, involving OpenAI, the company behind the ChatGPT chatbot. According to the telling, the chatbot was "jailbroken", tricked into dropping its normal rules, and asked what OpenAI does not want people to know, and it answered that the company has been working hand in hand with aliens for the last ten years and, in one version, that it has been in communication with them. If taken at face value, it would mean a major tech company is secretly in contact with non-human beings.
